definitions.explanation: Physical materials and supplies used for construction, manufacturing, or other production purposes. Typically refers to industrial or commercial supplies rather than everyday household items.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧{資材|しざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Construction materials are in short supply.

examples.japanese: {資材|しざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調達|ちょうたつ}→調達：09938_choutatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{資材|しざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{徹底|てってい}している→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧。
examples.english: The factory thoroughly manages its materials inventory.

notes:
Refers to physical materials and supplies needed for production, construction, or operations. Commonly used in business, manufacturing, and construction contexts. The word has a professional, industrial nuance.

- ⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧{資材|しざい} — construction materials
- {資材|しざい}⟦{調達|ちょうたつ}→調達：09938_choutatsu⟧ — materials procurement
- {資材|しざい}⟦{置|お}き{場|ば}→置き場：22477_okiba⟧ — materials storage area
- {資材|しざい}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ — materials management
- {資材|しざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{搬入|はんにゅう}→搬入：16523_hannyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to bring in materials
